items.partial_fix: Section 3.1 now states what the package records (router score, fallback, verification deterministic per the authors) and names each unspecified mechanic with an [ASK AUTHOR] marker; Section 3.2 marks what the seeds randomize.
items.reason: The claim definition, verification source, topic assignment, update rule and prior, train/evaluate separation, candidate definition and seed randomness are not in the package; stating them would invent method detail. Asked as checkpoint Q-005 and listed in open_issues.md.

items.where: Section 3.1 paragraph 3 (A2 collapses to global search; residual A0/A2 differences stated as unexplained with [ASK AUTHOR]); Section 4.3 rewritten; claim C005 narrowed in the claim map.

Section 3.2 paragraphs 2-3 (cost-run embedder not recorded, and why it matters) and Section 3.4 paragraphs 2-3 (explicit embedder mapping per experiment; classifier features and tuning marked as not recorded); new claim C039.

Section 3.2 paragraph 2 and Table 1 header and caption (seed basis of every column); Section 4.1 paragraph 1 (context tokens labelled seeds 66 to 110); Sections 3.2, 4.2 and 4.4 (route@1 denominator and the 'routed in 5 of 5 seeds' criterion stated as not recorded, limitation L025); unavailable corpus and code in 6.2. The missing denominators themselves are asked in Q-005.

Figure 3 re-rendered with the corrected line renderer: route@1 on the vertical axis with ticks, step 0 to 10 on the horizontal axis with ticks and the title 'Step' (registry x_label); caption and alt text name both axes; V3 passes.

Section 4.5 paragraph 1 (exact match above token-F1 for ASMOS+RAG flagged as not allowed by standard definitions; both metrics summarised); Table 2 caption summarises both metrics; Section 3.5 marks the metric definitions [ASK AUTHOR].
'small accuracy cost' removed from Discussion and Conclusion; Abstract, contribution 2, Section 5 and Section 7 say the size of the accuracy cost cannot be bounded; packet objective updated.

Section 4.4 final paragraph (RQ4 answered descriptively, untested and unmatched); Section 3.4 paragraph 2 (fairness conditions stated before the results); Section 4.2 final paragraph (route@1 descriptive, no test or denominator, chance about half with two agents); Appendix A (stationary run: multiples of 1/11, two-query gap, no test).
Section 5 paragraphs 1 and 3 and Section 7: 'small' removed; the accuracy cost is 'of unknown size' or 'cannot be bounded'.

Section 4.2 heading ('accuracy was lower in every recorded seed (untested)') and paragraph 1 (1 or 2 of 50 questions per seed; seeds not independent replications; neither size nor reliability established); limitation L023.

Abstract, contribution 3, Section 3.1 paragraph 3, Section 4.3, Section 5 and Section 7: the ablation is described as a routing-versus-no-routing contrast that cannot separate the learning process from a correctly set static ownership; claim C005 narrowed and its causal_design license removed.

Section 4.4 paragraph 1 ('lowest mean regret of the routers in this run') and final paragraph (descriptive, untested, not matched on tuning or update access); Section 3.4 paragraph 2 (thresholds, labels, no online baseline); limitation L022.

Section 3.4 paragraph 2 and Section 6.2 (no classifier updated online from the same labels is included; the comparison contrasts ASMOS with scheduled retraining); Section 7 names an online-updated classifier as a next question. Running that baseline needs the authors and is listed in open_issues.md.

Section 3.2 paragraph 4 (the saving is in recorded LLM usage per query, not a whole-system net saving; embedding, ownership updates and verification are not costed); Section 5 paragraph 3 (full cost ledger unknown); limitation L021.

Title ('A Small-Scale Study'), Abstract sentence 2 (two agents), Section 1 paragraph 1 (two agents; candidates are not agents), Section 3.4 paragraph 1 (new-topic agent count not recorded), limitation L024, Section 7 (larger teams as a next question).

Appendix A 'Stationary embedder run' (single run, no seeds, values multiples of 1/11, a two-query gap if 11 queries, no test); the main text keeps the negative lexical-hash result (Section 4.4 paragraph 2); claim C012 restated.

Section 4.2 final paragraph: 'learned ownership sent more queries to the correct owner' removed; route@1 values reported as descriptive with no test, no recorded denominator, and chance about half with two agents (limitation L025).

Table 2 caption and Section 4.5 paragraph 1: both metrics summarised (the combined system trails RAG by less on exact match, 0.625 against 0.7083), and the exact-match-above-token-F1 anomaly is stated.

Section 3.2 paragraph 3: the authors' statement is limited to the counting; the counted quantity depends on routing and hence on the embedder, which the cost result file does not record (claim C039); L008's effect on interpretation updated; Section 6.1 says the authors' unconfirmed-embedder statement concerns an earlier run not reported here.
